name: apple-calendar
description: Reads Apple Calendar on a Mac for what is waiting on you and what you are waiting on: unanswered invites, pending replies to your invites, and meetings that need preparation. Read only, enforced by a guard on every other tool.

before_tool.command: echo 'apple-calendar is read only: only list_calendars, list_events, list_events_quick, search_events, check_conflicts and find_duplicate_events may be called. Do not retry or look for another way to change a calendar.' >&2; exit 2
